text.p: Uranium Resources Inc said on Thursday that it received US$575,000 in cash from Professional Bank of Denver in a settlement, regarding what it described as an improper transfer of funds.

Uranium Resources said in a statement that its original lawsuit sought to recover $780,000 that it said was improperly transferred by Oren Benton, a former Uranium Resources officer, in January 1995 to accounts of Benton's other affiliated entities maintained at Professional Bank.
Uranium Resources said the company's total recovery is now 80 percent of the $1.08 million that was "improperly transferred" in January 1995.
Under the settlement, the company has preserved its rights regarding certain claims against Benton, it said.
The agreement settled an action that was pending in the Federal District Court in Denver.
